#Clean up and factor peak counts
```{r}
colnames(peak_counts) <- gsub(".mLb.clN.sorted.bam","",colnames(peak_counts))
rownames(peak_counts) <- peak_counts$Geneid
peak_counts <- peak_counts[, 7:ncol(peak_counts), drop = FALSE] %>% as.matrix()

colnames(peak_counts) <- sub("^LINC00667\\.", "LINC00667_", colnames(peak_counts))
colnames(peak_counts) <- sub("^LINCROR\\.", "LINCROR_", colnames(peak_counts))
colnames(peak_counts) <- sub("^FENDRR\\.", "FENDRR_", colnames(peak_counts))

col_data <- data.frame("sample_name" = colnames(peak_counts)) 

split_values <- strsplit(col_data$sample_name, "_")

View(split_values)

condition_values <- sapply(split_values, function(x) x[[1]])
time_values <- sapply(split_values, function(x) x[[2]])
replicate_values <- sapply(split_values, function(x) x[[3]])

col_data$time <- time_values
col_data$condition <- condition_values
col_data$replicate <- replicate_values

col_data$timepoint <- factor(col_data$time, levels = c("0h", "0.5h", "1h", "1.5h", "2h", "2.5h"))
levels(col_data$timepoint)
```

```{r}
# Store results in a list
dds_list <- list()
res_list <- list()

# Get unique conditions
conditions <- unique(col_data$condition)

# Loop through each condition
for (cond in conditions) {
  message("Processing condition: ", cond)
  
  # Subset col_data and counts
  sub_col_data <- col_data[col_data$condition == cond, ]
  sub_counts <- peak_counts[, sub_col_data$sample_name]
  
  # Ensure time is a factor with consistent levels
  sub_col_data$time <- factor(as.character(sub_col_data$time), 
                              levels = c("0h", "0.5h", "1h", "1.5h", "2h", "2.5h"))
levels(col_data$time)
  
  # Build DESeq2 object
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = sub_counts,
                                colData = sub_col_data,
                                design = ~ time)
  
  # Run DESeq2 with LRT test
  dds <- DESeq(dds, test = "LRT", reduced = ~1)
  
  # Store full DESeq object and results
  dds_list[[cond]] <- dds
  res_list[[cond]] <- results(dds)
}
save(dds_list, col_data, file = "/scratch/Shares/rinn/ML/ATAC_FULL_MODEL/results/all_atac_dds.RData")

# Create final dataframe to store all results
all_results_df <- data.frame()

# Loop through each condition
for (cond in names(dds_list)) {
  dds <- dds_list[[cond]]
  
  # Get all result names (skip intercept)
  res_names <- resultsNames(dds)[-1]
  
  for (res_name in res_names) {
    # Extract results
    res <- results(dds, name = res_name)
    
    # Convert to data frame, join with gene annotations
    tmp_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
      rownames_to_column("interval_id") %>%
      mutate(condition  = cond,
             result_name = res_name,
             timepoint = as.numeric(sub("time_([0-9\\.]+)h?_vs_0h?", "\\1", res_name))) %>%
      merge(peak_annotation %>% 
            dplyr::select(interval_id, Gene.Name, Nearest.PromoterID, 
                          Distance.to.TSS, Chr, Start, End)) %>% 
    unite(ucsc_coord, Chr, Start, remove = FALSE, sep = ":") %>%
    unite(ucsc_coord, ucsc_coord, End, sep = "-", remove = FALSE)
    
    # Append
    all_results_df <- bind_rows(all_results_df, tmp_df)
  }
}
save(all_results_df, col_data, file = "/scratch/Shares/rinn/ML/ATAC_FULL_MODEL/results/all_atac_res_df.RData")

# Loop through each condition
for (cond in names(dds_list)) {
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Filter padj ≤ 0.01
filtered_df <- all_results_df %>%
  filter(padj <= 0.05 & baseMean >= 100)

# Step 2: Compute max FC per gene per condition
maxfc_df <- filtered_df %>%
  group_by(condition, interval_id) %>%
  summarize(
    max_fc = log2FoldChange[which.max(abs(log2FoldChange))],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Join and filter for max_fc ≥ 0.58
filtered_df <- filtered_df %>%
  left_join(maxfc_df, by = c("condition", "interval_id")) %>%
  filter(max_fc >= 0.58 | max_fc <= -0.58)

# Step 4: Mark up/down direction
filtered_df <- filtered_df %>%
  mutate(
    up = log2FoldChange > 0,
    down = log2FoldChange < 0 
  )

# Step 5: Use only late timepoints to determine consistent genes
valid_time_points <- c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5)

trend_summary <- filtered_df %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% valid_time_points) %>%
  group_by(condition, interval_id) %>%
  summarize(
    up_count = sum(up, na.rm = TRUE),
    down_count = sum(down, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_comparisons = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_comparisons == length(valid_time_points)) %>%
  filter(up_count >= 1 | down_count >= 1)

gene_dominant_conditions <- trend_summary %>%
  # 计算每个基因在多少condition下上调/下调
  group_by(interval_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_up = sum(up_count > down_count),    # 上调的condition数量
    n_down = sum(down_count > up_count),  # 下调的condition数量
    dominant_direction = ifelse(n_up > n_down, "up", "down"),  # 主导方向
    dominant_conditions = ifelse(
      n_up > n_down,
      paste(condition[up_count > down_count], collapse = ", "),  # 上调的conditions
      paste(condition[down_count > up_count], collapse = ", ")  # 下调的conditions
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # 只保留主导方向的conditions（如果n_up == n_down，默认选"up"）
  filter(n_up != n_down)  # 可选：排除平局的情况

expanded_dominant <- gene_dominant_conditions %>%
  separate_rows(dominant_conditions, sep = ", ") %>%
  rename(condition = dominant_conditions) %>%
  select(interval_id, condition, dominant_direction)

final_sig_genes <- filtered_df %>%
  inner_join(expanded_dominant, by = c("interval_id", "condition")) %>%
  filter(
    (dominant_direction == "up" & up == TRUE) |
    (dominant_direction == "down" & down == TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(-dominant_direction)

final_sig_genes <- filtered_df %>%
  semi_join(final_sig_genes, by = c("interval_id", "condition"))
print(length(unique(final_sig_genes$interval_id)))
final_sig_genes <- final_sig_genes %>%
  left_join(gene_dominant_conditions, by = "interval_id") %>%
  select(-c(dominant_direction, dominant_conditions))

print(unique(col_data$condition))

sig_peaks_13_to_19 <- final_sig_genes %>%
  filter(n_up >=13 | n_down >= 13)
print(length(unique(sig_peaks_13_to_19$interval_id)))

# Comprehensive summary
filtered_df %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_unique_intervals = n_distinct(interval_id)
  )
```

```{r}
# Prepare log2FC data - add missing 0 timepoint with log2FC=0
log2fc_heatmap_data <- filtered_df %>%
  # Convert timepoint to character if it's numeric
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)) %>%
  # First get all unique gene-condition combinations
  distinct(condition, interval_id) %>%
  # Cross with required timepoints (as character)
  crossing(timepoint = c("0", "0.5", "1", "1.5", "2", "2.5")) %>%
  # Join back with original data
  left_join(
    filtered_df %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)), 
    by = c("condition", "interval_id", "timepoint")
  ) %>%
  # Set log2FC to 0 for timepoint 0 (whether originally present or not)
  mutate(log2FoldChange = ifelse(timepoint == "0", 0, log2FoldChange)) %>%
  # Remove any NA values that might exist for other timepoints
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  # Convert timepoint to factor with specified levels
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("0", "0.5", "1", "1.5", "2", "2.5")))

# Generate separate heatmaps for each condition
for(current_condition in unique(log2fc_heatmap_data$condition)) {
  p <- log2fc_heatmap_data %>%
    filter(condition == current_condition) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = reorder(interval_id, log2FoldChange), fill = log2FoldChange)) +
    geom_tile(color = NA, linewidth = 0) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#313695", "#4575b4", "#74add1", "#e0f3f8", "#f7f7f7", "#fdae61", "#f46d43", "#d73027", "#a50026"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(-1, -0.75, -0.5, -0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)),
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "log2FC",
    na.value = "grey90",
    oob = scales::squish,
    guide = guide_colorbar(
    barheight = unit(3, "cm"),
    barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm")))+
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("log2FC by Time -", current_condition),
      x = "Time (h)",
      y = "Peaks"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0))
  
  print(p)
  output_dir <- "/scratch/Shares/rinn/ML/ATAC_FULL_MODEL/figures/"
ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "heatmap_log2fc_", current_condition, ".pdf"), 
       width = 8, height = 10)
}
```

```{r}
load("/scratch/Shares/rinn/ML/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/HAGLR/results/HAGLR_rnaseq_list_for_atacseq.RData")

peak_annotation_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = peak_annotation$Chr,

                             interval_id = peak_annotation$interval_id)

sig_atac_gr <- peak_annotation_gr[peak_annotation_gr$interval_id %in% unique(HAGLR_atac_sig$interval_id)]

# making a promoters GenomicRanges with promoters function
promoters_gr <- promoters(genes, upstream = 1, downstream = 1)
promoters_df <- promoters_gr %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  
  # taking all genes except processed pseudogenes
  filter(gene_type %in% c("protein_coding", "processed_transcript", "bidirectional_promoter_lncRNA",
                          "antisense", "lincRNA", "sense_intronic"))

# finding overlaps of promoter regions in promoters_df
promoters_gr <- promoters_gr[promoters_gr$gene_id %in%promoters_df$gene_id]

# establishing peak centers building Ranges for sig atac peaks
# divide peak by two adn connect to start point
peak_centers <- start(sig_atac_gr) + round(width(sig_atac_gr)/2)
sig_atac_center <- GRanges(seqnames = seqnames(sig_atac_gr),
                           ranges = IRanges(start = peak_centers,
                                            end = peak_centers),
                           # naming peak
                           interval_id = sig_atac_gr$interval_id)

# setting peak to 50Kb up and downstream from peak center
offset <- 5e4

# creating 10Kb up and downstream of peak center with offset
# NOTE if you run twice it will affet the results !!
# Start and end are accessor functions to go into these values
start(sig_atac_center) <- start(sig_atac_center) - offset
end(sig_atac_center) <- end(sig_atac_center) + offset

# overlaps with TSS for sig atac peak centers
# NOTE the ordering of overlaps matters for the lines below
peak_tss_overlaps <- findOverlaps(promoters_gr, sig_atac_center)

# making Granges into data frame
atac_df <- sig_atac_center %>% as.data.frame()
promoters_df <- promoters_gr %>% as.data.frame()

# finding a bunch of overlapping features with atac peak centers

overlapping_df <- atac_df[peak_tss_overlaps@to, ]
overlapping_df$gene_id <- promoters_df$gene_id[peak_tss_overlaps@from]
overlapping_df$gene_name <- promoters_df$gene_name[peak_tss_overlaps@from]
overlapping_df$gene_tss <- promoters_df$start[peak_tss_overlaps@from]
overlapping_df$gene_chr <- promoters_df$seqnames[peak_tss_overlaps@from]
overlapping_df$gene_strand <- promoters_df$strand[peak_tss_overlaps@from]

# calculating distance from TSS
# subtracting peak center from the TSS to find distance*
overlapping_df <- overlapping_df %>%
  mutate(dist_to_tss = gene_tss - (start+offset),
         dist_to_peak = (start+offset) - gene_tss)

# some distances are positive and negative depending on up or down stream
# fixing to plot so they are all in the same 
# Flip the minus strand differences so that it's a TSS centric view
overlapping_df[overlapping_df$gene_strand == "-", "dist_to_peak"] <- -1* overlapping_df[overlapping_df$gene_strand == "-", "dist_to_peak"]

#change Distance.to.TSS to gr annotated dist_to_tss
HAGLR_atac_lfc_overlap_peaks_updated <- HAGLR_atac_lfc_overlap_peaks_updated %>%
  left_join(overlapping_df_filtered %>% select(interval_id, dist_to_tss), by = "interval_id") %>%
  mutate(Distance.to.TSS = dist_to_tss) %>%

# Create the unique_mapping with added RNA-seq trend, ATAC-seq trend, and picked_by_eye
unique_mapping <- HAGLR_atac_lfc_overlap_peaks_updated %>%
  distinct(sum_fc, gene_name, interval_id) %>%
  rowwise() %>%  # Ensure row-wise operations for `case_when` involving `str_split`
  mutate(
    # Mark RNA-seq trend as "down" if gene_name is in HAGLR_trend_sig_down, otherwise mark as "up"
    rna_seq_trend = case_when(
      any(str_split(gene_name, ";")[[1]] %in% HAGLR_trend_sig_down_filtered$gene_name) ~ "down",
      any(str_split(gene_name, ";")[[1]] %in% HAGLR_trend_sig_up_filtered$gene_name) ~ "up",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"  # If gene_name matches neither list, mark as "unknown"
    ),
    
    # Mark ATAC-seq trend based on sum_fc
    atac_seq_trend = case_when(
      sum_fc > 0 ~ "up",
      sum_fc < 0 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"  # If sum_fc is 0, mark as "unknown"
    ),
    
    # Check if RNA-seq and ATAC-seq trends are the same
    same_trend = case_when(
      rna_seq_trend == atac_seq_trend ~ "same",  # If trends are the same, mark as "same"
      TRUE ~ "different"  # Otherwise mark as "different"
    ),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()  # Reset row-wise grouping


# View the result
head(unique_mapping)
num_matches <- sum(unique_mapping$same_trend == "same")
```

```{r}
#  filter(interval_id %in% unique_mapping_match$interval_id)

all_counts_filtered <- all_counts %>% 
  filter(interval_id %in% unique_mapping$interval_id)

all_counts_filtered_long <- all_counts_filtered %>%
     pivot_longer(
       cols = -interval_id,  # Assuming 'gene_id' or a similar identifier column exists
       names_to = c("condition", "time_point", "replicate"),
       names_pattern = "^(HAGLR|GFP)[._](\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?h?)[._]REP(\\d+)$",
       values_to = "counts"
    ) %>%
     mutate(
        time_point = as.numeric(gsub("h", "", time_point)), 
        replicate = as.numeric(replicate),
        condition = ifelse(condition == "novageneGFP", "GFP", condition) 
    )

#all_counts_filtered_long <- all_counts_filtered_long %>%
#  left_join(unique_mapping_match)

#get all peak that changed not considering if it match RNAseq pattern or not
all_counts_filtered_long <- all_counts_filtered_long %>%
  left_join(unique_mapping)

ggplot(all_counts_filtered_long, aes(x = time_point, y = counts, color = condition, linetype = condition)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_name + interval_id, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Time Point (h)", 
    y = "Peak Counts", 
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("HAGLR" = "darkred", "GFP" = "blue")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("HAGLR" = "solid", "GFP" = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(all_counts_filtered_long$time_point)) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```
